obligations.text: Every byte of a page under `docs/reference/` outside its `notes` region is the output of `spec-spine reference generate` for the committed request `docs/reference/request.json` at the pinned spec-spine version; no change edits a generated region by hand, and a page that is wrong is corrected by changing the spec, code or index it was generated from.

`make gate` and this spec's acceptance run `spec-spine reference check --request docs/reference/request.json`, which exits nonzero on a missing, changed, orphaned or malformed page or a stale ledger, so a change that alters a spec, an owned unit's index shard or the request without regenerating the pages does not pass.

The request exports every registry spec (`select: all`) to `docs/reference`, with `traceability` false and `catalog` null until the corpus declares spec-169 relations or a spec-162 catalog, and with spec-spine's default limits.
`make refresh` runs `compile`, `index`, `reference generate` and `index` again, in that order, so one invocation leaves the registry, the index and the pages mutually current.

`docs/reference/README.md` is the directory's authored index: it says what the pages are, that they are generated and how to regenerate them, that `notes` is the only authored region, and where the current status of every spec is read; it lists no spec by status or number, so it cannot go stale.

record.summary: Commits one spec-spine reference page per spec under `docs/reference/`, generated by `spec-spine reference generate` (spec-spine spec 166) from the registry and the committed codebase index, so every spec's lifecycle, obligations, owned units, amendments and declared acceptance can be read without the tool. `make refresh` regenerates the pages with the shards; `make gate` and this spec's acceptance run `spec-spine reference check`, which fails on any difference. The pages are generated and left out of the AI review (#586): a wrong page is fixed in the spec or code that produced it, never in the page. The one authored part of a page is its `notes` region. Ratified by the owner on 2026-11-10 (A-92).
